newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CRE grants natgas distribution permit.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CRE grants natgas distribution permit.

text.p: Mexico's Energy Regulatory Commission (CRE) granted the first natural gas distribution permit for self-consumption groups to the consortium, Servicios Industriales y Administrativos del Noroeste, S. de R.L. de S.V. (SIAN), a CRE statement said on Thursday.
Regulations stipulate that self-consumption groups may only be composed of users that consume natural gas for industrial, commercial or service use.
SIAN's transportation system will have an overall capacity of 273 million cubic feet per day, the statement said.
